title: Philippines’ Inflation Heats Up for First Time in Five Months
summary: Philippine inflation gained pace again in September, ending four months of deceleration as fuel prices surged.

title: New World Launches Exchange Offer for Nearly $1 Billion of Bonds

title: Nidec Scandal Sends Bonds to Bottom in Test for New President
summary: Scandal-tainted Nidec Corp., which grew from a Kyoto startup into the world’s largest manufacturer of precision motors, has fallen to the bottom rank of the yen debt market by one measure, leaving its new president with a challenge to restore investor confidence.
